q: Why do I wear a biker jacket? I like making people scared of me. I get treated better by the servers in the coffeehouses in the gaybourhood. Not to mention getting looked at by the dykes/bykes. :) Without the jacket, I get pushed around more on the subway, people don't get out of my way on crowded sidewalks, and men try to intimidate me -- I'm a wee femmy thing, most of the time.
1999 March 12, A, “Re: bisexual attire”, in soc.bi (Usenet):

e: From by or by- + knife. Compare Scots byknife, byknyfe.
